parent_v5.key_result: directionality changed both source/history and reachability-envelope information, whereas temporal order further contracted world/source identity but did not add full-coverage robust-impossibility recovery

scientific_question: Which evidence channels merely distinguish worlds inside the same reachability target class, and which cross a target-equivalence boundary and change the ecological possibility/impossibility envelope?

analysis_base.landscapes: the exact 384 v5 latent landscapes and directed candidate-world universes
analysis_base.baseline_evidence: all truth-positive non-source nodes as unordered directed-static positive evidence
analysis_base.candidate_worlds: source x barrier-level x analyst-rule directed worlds that survive the full static positive set

targets.world_identity: exact candidate source x barrier x analyst world
targets.reachability_class: exact directed reachable-node set of the candidate world
targets.robust_impossibility_envelope: locally permissive nodes unreachable in every surviving world

frozen_additional_evidence_channels.T_temporal: all full-positive anchors must be reached by candidate directed BFS depth <= their truth directed BFS depth
frozen_additional_evidence_channels.S_source: candidate source must equal the known-truth source
frozen_additional_evidence_channels.B_barrier: candidate barrier-density level must equal the known-truth barrier level
frozen_additional_evidence_channels.R_analyst: candidate analyst rule must equal relative_edge_q70

subset_audit: evaluate all 16 subsets of {T_temporal,S_source,B_barrier,R_analyst} against the same full-positive baseline survivor fiber

single_channel_classification.identity_only: world count decreases but exact reachability-class count and robust-impossibility envelope are unchanged
single_channel_classification.target_refining: exact reachability-class count decreases but robust-impossibility envelope is unchanged

evidence_burden.reachability_target_burden: minimum number of additional evidence channels needed so every survivor has the truth world's exact reachable set
evidence_burden.full_world_burden: minimum number of additional evidence channels needed to leave exactly the truth world

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every eligible row, minimum reachability-target evidence burden is <= minimum full-world evidence burden.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row requires strictly fewer additional channels to identify the truth reachability class than to identify the full truth world.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if burdens are equal in every row.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row has temporal evidence that contracts the survivor-world fiber while leaving the robust-impossibility envelope unchanged.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every temporal world contraction also changes robust impossibility.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row gains at least one robustly impossible locally permissive node after truth-source evidence is added.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if source evidence never enlarges robust impossibility.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one of the direct barrier-state or analyst-rule channels is envelope-changing in at least one eligible row.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if neither channel ever changes robust impossibility.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: The combined S_source + B_barrier + R_analyst evidence leaves exactly one candidate world in every eligible row.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/world-definition failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across the four single channels and all eligible rows, at least three of the four classification categories occur.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if evidence effects collapse to fewer than three categories.

secondary_outputs: distribution of target-specific versus full-world minimum burdens
fraction of rows where baseline full positives already identify the reachability class
fraction where temporal evidence changes reachability-class count without changing robust impossibility
canonical minimum evidence subset for target and world identity
overlap between source-identification gain and robust-impossibility gain
claim_boundary: Direct source/barrier/analyst observations are known-truth diagnostic channels, not claims that these variables are easy to measure in nature.
Unit channel count is not field cost.
Reachability-class identification is target-specific and does not establish historical truth.
Evidence categories are conditional on the frozen directed candidate-world universe.
stop_rules: Do not add a fifth evidence channel after scoring.
Do not change channel semantics after scoring.
Do not weight evidence channels after scoring.
Do not replace the exact reachability-set target with a favorable coarser target after scoring.
